lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Mn2O4 (reduced formula LiMnO2) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R3m (No. 15), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Li centers in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Mn centers adopt an octahedral environment with three Li and three O neighbors. The O centers have two geometric neighbors, one Li and one Mn. Validated polyhedron contacts indicate corner- and edge-sharing between Li and Mn octahedra, plus edge-sharing among Li octahedra, forming a three-dimensional periodic connectivity network.
